outside_window.finding: Deal 1, part-funded by Chariot's US$12m deposit to Etu Energias (20% of Block 14 / 10% of Block 14K, economics of about 4,000 bopd, net NPV10 >US$100m at $60/bbl), is guided to complete in 'H2 2026, subject to regulatory approvals'. No completion RNS yet, and no source dates it to the interim. Deal 2 (the Chevron pre-emption, 31% of Block 14) closes 'early 2027' per ANPG approval. Either completion is a positive catalyst, but neither is dated inside the window.

The 1-for-25 share consolidation was approved at the 22 Sep AGM, with timing 'at the discretion of the Directors'. It is cosmetic economically, but an unadjusted Yahoo series would show a ~25x jump on the effective date. No effective date has been announced, so it is not expected inside the window. Flagged for the resolver.

Funding overhang. Year-end cash was US$1.2m and the auditor flagged a going-concern material uncertainty. The US$24.3m March raise was half lent to Etu (US$12m). About 1.36bn 2.4p warrants from the Feb 2026 raise sit just below spot (2.6p). Together these make a placing or warrant-driven supply plausible after the rerating, but no document dates a raise, and the money would fund an accretive Angola ramp. A financing is a question and not a sign, so it stays unsized.
